$comment: Machine-readable surface for /apply-pattern. Human spec: patterns/presale/pattern.md. Second validation-experiment pattern (chief-wiggum#236): checkout on an unbuilt product with HONEST pre-order framing — the strongest evidence class (5, money) a pre-build bet can produce. Pre-registration/vanity-lint invariants are grounded in the in-repo assumption.py mechanism; the page/checkout invariants are design-derived (no shipped app has run this stamped experiment yet — honest per issue #139's allowance).
title: Presale (Honest Pre-Order)
applies_when: a demand assumption is validated at click/time strength and the bet needs commitment-class evidence to earn `building`
Blank's validation exit: purchase orders, not enthusiasm — the evidence-strength floor on bet.py transition building requires strength >=4
you can state price and a delivery window honestly and refund promptly if the bet dies
there is an audience to convert (e.g. landing-page-smoke-test signups)
components: honest-preorder-page: states plainly that the product is NOT built yet, the price, and the expected delivery window BEFORE any payment step
real-money-checkout-stub: a checkout stub the operator wires to a real payment provider — a charge (or authorized deposit) is the datum; a fake charge is fraud, not a test
pre-registered-binding: conversion threshold hashed into the portfolio journal before launch (assumption.py test card, strength 5)
refund-on-kill: killing or pivoting the bet before delivery refunds every pre-order promptly; the refund obligation is a wind-down cost in the harvest check
per-cohort-rate-metric: visitor-to-preorder conversion per cohort; cumulative revenue/preorder totals are rejected as success criteria

invariants.$comment: 001-002 realized by the in-repo validation engine (scripts/assumption.py); 003-005 are design-derived, honestly flagged until first grounded use.

cluster.statement: Pre-registered conversion bar: the presale binds to a test card (evidence strength 5, money) whose threshold block was content-hashed into the portfolio journal BEFORE the checkout went live; the verdict is recorded only against that original hash.

realized_as.code: scripts/assumption.py (card-create threshold hash + verdict enforcement, chief-wiggum#236)

cluster.statement: Per-cohort rate, never a revenue counter: the success criterion is visitor→preorder conversion per cohort; cumulative preorder or gross revenue totals are rejected as success criteria.

Honest pre-order framing: the page states that the product is not yet built, the price, and the expected delivery window BEFORE any payment step; a checkout that hides non-existence is fraud, not an experiment.

Money means money: the experiment's datum is a real charge or authorized deposit through a real payment provider; a simulated charge, a 'fake door' at the pay button, or a free reservation counted as a preorder invalidates the strength-5 claim (it is click evidence at best).

Refund-on-kill: if the bet is killed or pivoted before delivery, every pre-order is refunded promptly per the stated policy; the outstanding refund obligation is counted as wind-down cost in the harvest check, never left off the books.

Visual design is chosen, not converged (same clause as landing-page-smoke-test INV-LPS-006 — a presale page is equally outward-facing): the scaffold is a structure only; the page's visual design must be presented as >=6 deliberately distinct rendered variants, grounded in a current-craft reference <=90 days stale (docs/design-taste.md, chief-wiggum#250), with a human pick recorded before the page ships (chief-wiggum#249). A taste checkpoint is a human checkpoint, not a lintable property — no gate script realizes this invariant.

price_usd.description: The pre-order price (or deposit amount), stated on the page before the payment step.

delivery_window.description: Honest expected delivery window (e.g. 'March 2027') — stated before payment.

checkout_endpoint.description: Where the checkout stub creates the payment session (wire to a real provider before launch).

refund_policy.default: Full refund, no questions asked, any time before delivery.
refund_policy.description: The refund promise shown before payment; the kill/pivot path must honor it (INV-PRE-005).

success_metrics.$comment: Per-cohort rates only (INV-PRE-002). The bound test card's threshold is the pre-registered pass bar.

metrics.desc: completed pre-orders / unique visitors per cohort — the experiment's primary measure
voluntary refunds requested before delivery / pre-orders per cohort — buyer's remorse erodes the strength-5 claim
traffic + processing spend / pre-orders per cohort (counts against the bet envelope)

protected_paths: the stamped presale page + checkout stub (the framing block and price are what was pre-registered)
